DECISIONS (recorded inline in the spec, not parked): (1) The 0-9 dial and the appetite class are TWO first-class configurations — the class (per family) is the permission KIND (OFF/RESERVED/PROBE/SPEND, and what condition attaches), the dial (per model) is the RATE/eagerness (0-9); both consulted in selection. (2) Dial semantics: 0 excludes (hard forbid, 'DO NOT USE'); 1-9 = weight in a weighted draw (probability proportional to dial); the dial NEVER excludes a >=1 candidate (rate reduction is not prohibition); dial 9 = modal whenever qualified. A 5-vs-4 dial is a defined, checkable 5:4 draw ratio. (3) Dead-level disposition, decided per level: conserve RETIRED (no branch today — filterQualified treats it exactly as spend; its meaning 'use less, keep using' is precisely the dial's 1-3 range, a rate not a permission kind); off/spend kept as classes; reserved/probe KEPT and now SPECIFIED as row flags (reserved task types / probe-flagged rows) that the class gate reads, because the operator values them ('1 is less informative than RESERVE and PROBE'). (4) Dial inheritance is materialized: family default dial + per-model model_dials override; a model whose family has no default dial is a parse error, never an invented default. (5) Selection order (ORC-POL-9): class gate -> dial-0 forbid -> qualification (methodology §5; unmeasured eligible per D027) -> dial-weighted draw -> cost REPORTED ONLY (T772 ratified: cost removed from model choice entirely). 'All else equal' = survives class + dial-0 + qualification; among those the dial is the sole discriminator — the operator's 'dice roll leans deepseek, all else equal'. (6) Cooldown = prohibition, distinct from the dial (rate reduction); every cooldown carries scope (model/family/fleet) + reason + end. Reason enumeration: provider-limit (today's automatic case), graceful-shutdown, reserve-queue-for-refactor, preserve-tokens-before-reset, operator-manual. Three end-forms: duration / until (the managent tell pause --until-done <T-id> mechanism generalized to a family or fleet) / indefinite (visible, never silently expiring). (7) The operator's dial reference table — ollama-cloud 0, claude-fable 1, local 1, claude 4, deepseek 5, ox-alpha 9 — is the new initial config, superseding §7c.11's 2026-08-22 numbers; the ORC-POL-5 worked-example JSON now carries family class + default dial + model_dials, schema_version 2. (8) Worked example in the spec: a plain audit row (27% task type) admits opus/sonnet/haiku(4) + dspro/dsflash(5) + ox-alpha(9), weights sum 31; haiku 4->5 renormalizes the draw (12.9% -> 15.6%, ox-alpha 29.0% -> 28.1%). (9) §12.5 records the one remaining design-open: dial eagerness vs D027 least-data among equal dials (recommend uniform among equal dials).
